risk_description: Provider single-turn completion burst exceeding arm ceiling
mitigation_control: Single synchronous request burst limit capped at 16384 tokens by remote provider; prompt+completion bounded

risk_description: Prompt context inflation at reserve boundary causing aggregate breach
mitigation_control: Two-layer pre-dispatch gate checks gross remaining >= 45000 tokens before dispatch; clamps arm ceiling

risk_description: Process crash or SIGKILL during in-flight turn creating unobserved provider tokens
mitigation_control: 14-point summary validation gate; fail-closed abort on missing truncated or unverified telemetry

risk_description: Prior arm functional test assertion failure aborting Pentad before Candidate 5
mitigation_control: Execution policy explicitly set to diagnostic_continue logging errors without halting run

risk_description: Subscription rolling usage window exhaustion triggering HTTP 429 rate limit
mitigation_control: Formal classification as SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA_IMPACT_NOT_VERIFIED; manual human dashboard check required

risk_description: Cross-process dynamic ceiling desynchronization or arithmetic overflow
mitigation_control: Explicit math clamp [Math]::Min(1500000 2500000 - SpentA) with schema nonce and hash checks

risk_description: Stale or duplicate run summary artifact incorrectly passed to Invocation 2
mitigation_control: Run nonce timestamp check requires summary timestamp greater than invocation start time
